proposal: Stop a 4-day visual-qa ↔ ui-fix stalemate loop by teaching the visual-qa prompt (scripts/agents/visual-qa.md) that the floating «Assistent» button resting over a MID-agenda/news row is a DESIGN.md-sanctioned owner decision (§ Hjelperen, WP-146 variant D), NOT an overflow/occlusion bug — so it stops emitting a daily false-HIGH. Added a 'Design-sanctioned patterns — do NOT flag these' section: the float-over mid-list rows is the intended iOS 26 idiom ('Agendaen/Nyheter scroller rolig UNDER knappen'); the ONLY assistant-button issue worth a finding is the guarantee that must hold — the button never occludes the LAST row or the footer ('okkluderer ALDRI siste agenda-/Nyheter-rad') — which stays a real HIGH; and at ≈900px the button sits in the empty margin and overlaps nothing. Sharpens an existing prompt; adds no machinery; touches no protected path.
evidence: visual-qa-log.json (2026-08-02, verdict 'issues') flags the assistant-fab overlapping an agenda row as HIGH at 375 + 393px, and its own notes say this is 'at least the fourth consecutive day this exact bug has been observed (2026-07-30, 2026-07-31, 2026-08-01, 2026-08-02), landing on a different row each time because the agenda content shifts day to day' — the tell of a fixed float-over, not a real overflow.

ui-fix-log.json (2026-08-02, action 'none', 4th consecutive no-op) correctly refuses to touch it and cites the design contract: 'DESIGN.md §345–370 (WP-146 variant D, an explicit OWNER decision) sanctions exactly this: the button floats over content and «Agendaen … scroller rolig UNDER knappen»; only the LAST row is guaranteed clear, and that guarantee holds.' Both of visual-qa's proposed remedies (bottom-padding, shrink-below-breakpoint) are already exhausted (main.wrap padding-bottom:88px > the FAB's ~58px; glyph-only 44px at the HIG minimum).

ui-fix's own escalation names this exact fix: 'to stop this HIGH finding recurring … accept the sanctioned float-over and recalibrate the QA severity to reflect DESIGN.md §345–370.' Recalibrating the QA prompt is improve's remit (a prompt-misfiring pattern); ui-fix cannot, since editing the QA prompt is outside its loop.

DESIGN.md § Hjelperen (Rev. 21.07.2026, WP-146 variant D, eier-beslutning) confirms verbatim: the button floats bottom-trailing, 'okkluderer ALDRI siste agenda-/Nyheter-rad', and 'Agendaen/Nyheter scroller rolig UNDER knappen' — the iOS 26 floating-button idiom (jf. Foto/Musikk). So the daily HIGH contradicts the normative design contract.

npm test: 1368 passed (81 files) after the edit — unchanged count; tests/agent-prompts.test.js only requires referenced .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md paths to exist (this edit cites DESIGN.md, no skill path), so the coherence gate stays green.
notes: Expected effect: visual-qa stops raising the assistant-fab mid-row overlap as high/medium, so its verdict is no longer pushed to 'issues' by a DESIGN-sanctioned pattern, and ui-fix stops burning a run/day disposing of it. The real guarantee (last row + footer never occluded) is preserved as a HIGH, so a genuine regression (e.g. the 88px reserve breaking) is still caught.

How we'll know it worked: within a few days visual-qa-log.json no longer carries the assistant-fab overlap as a high/medium finding on the mid-agenda row, and ui-fix-log.json stops recording the recurring 'action: none' no-op for it. If visual-qa later flags the LAST row/footer being covered, that is a NEW, real finding and should still fire.

Deliberately NOT touching the frontend or DESIGN.md: the overlap is an explicit owner design decision; overriding it (dock the control, full-width bar, right gutter, hide the FAB) is owner-level and forbidden by DESIGN.md. The right lever is the QA severity calibration, which is exactly what ui-fix escalated for.
